INSERT OR IGNORE INTO qual_snapshots (id, pursuit_id, slot, analysis_date, should_scores, should_evidence, can_scores, can_evidence) VALUES ('acme-qual-1', 'acme-pursuit', 1, '2016-10-04', '[2,1,-1,1,0,-1,-1]', '["Target of $25M, Existing pipeline of $15-20M","Contract renewal in closing phase, existing run rate business and moderate growth over time. Danger of reduced volume of business due to expenditure cut backs and increased competition in core business from alternative network carriers.","Anticipate increased pressure on terms and conditions, contract overhead, reduced customer workforce to administer relationship","Potential for hidden costs in execution, however mitigated against significant upside potential in expansion of scope and higher level outcome based service offerings","Well known market leader, global expansion opportunity, growth in to new divisions within the account (UC, contact centre, managed services)","Unusual resourocing needs","Established solutions set, advances our desired product strategy with global business, however likely to need to include new partners and customisation needed."]', '[2,1,1,1,1,1,0]', '["Decision makers are under pressure to respond to market price challenges, but excited about the potential of the outsourcing process, personally accountable for the outcome, and strong improvement in confidence that we are aligned to ACME and growing assurance of our ability to execute.","Key metrics are unit cost of sale and production volume; aligned with relevance of our mining services offering and global capacity for service.","Connected to key influencers, relationship with the CTO Maestro is growing with executive interlock established, strong relationships with CTO key vice presidents and heads of department.","Budget is secured and clearly defined. Concerns around experience of NGO evaluation team however this works in our favour due to ability to influence. Access to client data will form the following engagement phase of roadshow then RFT.","Previous low engagement score and lack of confidence in sales team. Relationship has improved significantly over last 4 months and ease of doing business has improved.","our value proposition is clear and closely aligned with customer business requirements. Pressure from similar capabilities from global systems integrators.","Timelines are opaque however customer business challenges and high level requirements are clearly communicated."]');
